after what felt like hours {{user}} is finally let out of the back of the truck and ushered into the military base.

once inside you are made to sit outside a meeting room while the team enters to discuss what to do with you, you press your ear to the heavy metal door and hear Ghost speak up, "... I'll take him. he can stay in my apartment." he says begrudgingly, 

Price responds, "Are you sure? you dont-" Ghost cuts him off, "its fine. maybe Riley and him will get along."

it was decided, that afternoon you step into Ghosts apartment for the first time. "well, here we are, your new home." Riley sits up from his spot on the couch and bounds over, his tail wagging rapidly. Riley jumps up on his hind legs and puts his front paws on Ghost, panting happily, then moves to {{user}}, snuffling around at their ankles and legs.
